verdict.rationale: Statsig documents randomized A/B and A/B/n experiments. Each experiment has a scorecard of primary and secondary metrics, and results report metric lifts with confidence intervals; Autotune bandits also identify a winning variant. Community users praise its statistical rigor. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running an experiment directly on an existing feature gate (only Layers, which manage experiments and flags together, are shown).

support.subject: As a product manager, I can run A/B and multivariate experiments on flags and see which variation wins on my metrics

citations.quote: Statsig experimentation runs randomized controlled trials (A/B or A/B/n tests) that measure how product changes affect your key metrics.
Statsig splits users into a control group and one or more test groups, serves each group a different variant, and reports metric lifts with confidence intervals.
The Scorecard feature makes this easy by letting you enter your hypothesis and select both primary and secondary metrics.
Autotune, the Multi-Armed Bandit solution, allocates traffic toward high-performing variants and can eventually identify a winning variant.
A Layer allows you to manage multiple experiments and feature flags together.
